Bachelor of Example Studies

Overview

Unit A1: Students in this unit develop skills in analysis, communication and teamwork through weekly seminars, laboratory classes and a project that applies the methods of the discipline to a current problem. Assessment includes written work, a presentation and a final examination. Prerequisite knowledge is assumed at the level of the earlier units of the major.

Entry requirements

International applicants must meet the minimum entry requirements for this course.

Prerequisites

English: Units 3 and 4 – a study score of at least 30 in English (EAL) or 25 in any other English.

Mathematics: Units 3 and 4 – a study score of at least 25 in Mathematical Methods.

Prior qualification

Applicants with prior tertiary study must have completed at least 24 credit points with a minimum average mark of 60%.
